landfall.text: Continuing to move northwestward, it is likely to cross Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts between Nellore and Tuni, around noon of 20th November, 2026 as a very severe cyclonic storm with the maximum sustained wind speed of 120-130 kmph gusting to 145 kmph.

Continuing to move northwestward, it is likely to cross Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam, around noon of 20th November, 2026 as a very severe cyclonic storm with the maximum sustained wind speed of 120-130 kmph gusting to 145 kmph.

Continuing to move northwestward, it is likely to cross Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam, around noon of 20th November, 2026 as a very severe cyclonic storm with the maximum sustained wind speed of 120-130 kmph gusting to 145 kmph.

Continuing to move north-northwestward, it is likely to cross Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam, around noon of 20th November, 2026 as a severe cyclonic storm with the maximum sustained wind speed of 100-110 kmph gusting to 120 kmph.

Continuing to move north-northwestward, it is likely to cross North Andhra Pradesh & Yanam and South Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, by noon of 20th November, 2026 as a severe cyclonic storm with the maximum sustained wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph.
